reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:16f488cb6307d953d159211c94fc5ff7]] First, I wanted to say, the kit I received first was not complete but one call to amazon and  I had my replacement (in full) 2 days later. The forms are small (1-10) but good and the file is ok too, however the brush that comes in the kit is one of my favorite polygel brushes I have ever used!!!

reviews.t: Less is More!! Build your way UP 😉

Build your foundation rather than SLATHER on alot at one time 🙃 I wasted alot of product messing up , using to much gel.

Can't wait to try another color

I have the markartt poly gel which works very well even with alcohol. This one not so much. It doesnt come with slip solution, sooo if you have none the alternative is rubbing alcohol. claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the vibrant, beautiful colors and the thermal color-changing effect.
Many customers find the polygel easy to work with, especially for beginners.
Some reviewers report missing items or incomplete kits, though customer service resolved the issues.
A few reviewers complain about the accessories (dual forms, file, stones) being low quality or not fitting well.
Some users note the product is sticky or stiff and can be tricky to work with, and a few mention nails popping off.
